proposed_registry_state: open until this patch merges, then fixed; not verified
behavior: Certifies only actual validated_field_facts / validated_structured_facts with generation_surfaced is True; attempted and surfaced attribution must both identify configured local model. Requires current owner receipt persisted, scoped to tenant/field, no action/decision/candidate previews, nonempty claims and matching surfaced answer. Existing RAG and decision authority constraints remain. Metadata/docs/CLI help now disclose the optional audit write; scope is advisor_chat (including configured tools and advice/tool audit/approval persistence), not authority promotion. A requested write does not claim persistence.

tests.command: env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. sahool-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests_v9/test_ai_rag_live_certification.py

red.failure_meaning: Real published runtime response falsely rejected; fabricated old generated_grounded+succeeded response falsely accepted.

tests.positive: Runs real build_evidence_response and shared owner fact validator on canonical fixture. HTTP provider, retrieval and receipt persistence are replaced. No live I/O.
tests.negative: Legacy unreachable contract, evidence-only mode, suppressed/failed/blocked/not-attempted status, false/string/absent surfaced flag, missing/wrong attribution, empty RAG, invalid guardrail, blocked owner receipt, unpersisted receipt all reject.

metadata_red.scope: New metadata assertions against pre-metadata patch

tests.metadata: Default and disabled generation remain read_only=True/audit_write_requested=False; every reached chat request, even failed certification, marks read_only=False/audit_write_requested=True. HARNESS_INVALID with generation requested uses audit_write_requested=null and read_only=False conservatively.

limitations: No commit, PR, merge or deployment performed by agent.
No live LLM/provider/DB calls; source tests cannot establish runtime verified.
